headline: HSC Physics error: 4 teachers show-caused by education board
summary: The education board has issued show-cause notices to four teachers following errors found in the HSC Physics question paper.
details: Four teachers have been issued show-cause notices after errors were discovered in the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) Physics question paper.
The action was taken by the education board to ensure the quality and accuracy of the national examinations.
The teachers involved in the question setting process are now required to explain their negligence in the question paper's preparation.
This development follows concerns raised by students and educators regarding the accuracy of the questions in the Physics paper.
The board is reviewing the process to prevent such errors from occurring in future examinations.
caption:
Errors in the HSC Physics paper? 4 teachers are now facing show-cause notices.

Four teachers have been issued show-cause notices after errors were discovered in the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) Physics question paper.

The action was taken by the education board to ensure the quality and accuracy of the national examinations.

The teachers involved in the question setting process are now required to explain their negligence in the question paper's preparation.

This development follows concerns raised by students and educators regarding the accuracy of the questions in the Physics paper.

The board is reviewing the process to prevent such errors from occurring in future examinations.

headline: Bus services resume in Rajshahi after union election dispute settled
summary: Long-distance and internal routes returned to normal on Tuesday night after transport workers reached an agreement on the union election process.
details: Bus services on both long-distance and internal routes from Rajshahi resumed around 9:30pm on Tuesday. This followed an agreement between transport workers over the election process for the Rajshahi District Motor Workers’ Union.
caption:
Bus services in Rajshahi are back on track after a strike left passengers stranded.

Bus services on both long-distance and internal routes from Rajshahi resumed around 9:30pm on Tuesday. This followed an agreement between transport workers over the election process for the Rajshahi District Motor Workers’ Union.
